summary.en: A set of tiles moves from one layout to another, tile after tile: each one lifts off the page, travels to its new place, takes its new size and settles into its turn.
summary.zh: 一组瓦片从一种排版逐片换到另一种：每片先抬起、走到新位置，再长成新尺寸、落定到新角度。

fits: Re-sorting a gallery, a storyboard or a set of screenshots; showing one set of items in a second arrangement (archive, feature, fan).
notFor: Content that changes while it moves (use a scene); one or two tiles (use card-portal or a push); text-heavy tiles (the lift and the turn blur small text).

intent.en: The layout itself is thinking: the same set of items re-sorts into a new arrangement while the eye follows each one, so the viewer sees one collection read another way.
intent.zh: 让观众看见“布局在思考”：同一批内容换一种排法，每一片都能被眼睛跟到新位置，读到“同样的东西，另一种看法”。

content.en: 8–12 tiles of pictures or screenshots (little or no text) and two layouts among grid, mosaic and cascade; pictures with their subject near the centre (cascade crops to portrait).
content.zh: 8–12 张图片或截图瓦片（少字或无字），在 grid、mosaic、cascade 中选两种排法；主体放在画面中部（cascade 会裁成竖幅）。

fits.zh: 重排图库、分镜板或一组截图；把同一批内容换一种排法给观众看（档案 → 精选 → 摊开）。

notFor.zh: 移动时内容也在变（用场景）；只有一两片（用 card-portal 或推）；满是小字的瓦片（抬起和旋转会糊）。

pairs.note: the full screen around it: switch, caption and headline

en: Put the subject of each picture near its centre; portrait prints crop landscape pictures to a strip.
zh: 每张图的主体放在中部；竖幅相纸会把横图裁成中间一条。

upstream.name: 三段布局重排
upstream.summary: 12 张瓦片在规则网格、feature mosaic、对角瀑布串三种排版间连续变形，位置宽高各自插值、逐片微错峰，段间留 hold
upstream.use: "同一批内容多种看法"的陈列转场：作品集/模板库/相册产品的布局能力展示
upstream.energy: 中（连续流动的重排，无爆点，气质从容）
